item.text: There isn’t an existing token file or Tailwind config, so I’m adding the tokens as global CSS custom properties. I’ll include Tailwind v4 theme aliases too, so the spacing and color tokens are available both as CSS variables and utility classes.

Added global design tokens in [src/index.css](/tmp/bench2-ht3j8a7h/repo/src/index.css): primary `#4f46e5`, Inter as the display and default font, and a 4px-based spacing scale. The primary color, display font, and spacing extensions are also available through Tailwind v4 theme utilities.

Inter is loaded from Google Fonts, so it requires network access in the browser.
